description: Preparation of a Rehabilitation and Management Mechanism for maintaining the water quality and environmental integrity of the Gregory Lake, Nuwara Eliya at an optimal level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Considering the ecological significance of the Gregory Lake in Nuwara Eliya, the lake and its surrounding area were declared as an Environmental Protection Area by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2007-03-05. However, due to the impact of various activities within the catchment area and the vicinity of the lake, it has been observed that the water quality and environmental condition of the lake have significantly deteriorated. The Central Environmental Authority has conducted several studies on the water quality of Gregory Lake, Nuwara Eliya and has confirmed that levels of phosphate, nitrogen, and biochemical oxygen far exceed the standard quality level available in normal water. Accumulation of slit in the reservoir and waterways due to sediment deposition over several decades, the inflow of agricultural runoff including fertilizer and pesticides from the catchment area, the discharge of wastewater and solid waste into the lake as a result of urban activities have been found as key factors contributing to the deterioration of the quality of the water. Taking these factors into account, and considering the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to establish a coordinated, science-based mechanism for the sustainable maintenance of water quality and the surrounding environment of Gregory Lake and its catchment area, the Cabinet decided to appoint an Oversight and Management Committee chaired by the Deputy Minister of Environment, as well as an Officials’ Committee comprising of the representatives from relevant state institutions designated as the ‘Gregory Lake Conservation and Rehabilitation Working Committee’.
